region_label: Cool & unusual — estates, inn buyouts, compounds
notes: Beat = character, not geography: small-inn buyouts, historic houses, compounds, island/boat-access houses, glamping villages, within ~90 min of Tampa (stretched to 2.5h for Cedar Key, Micanopy, Mount Dora, River Ranch). METHOD: Airbnb blocks WebFetch but not curl with a browser UA — I ran real DATED searches (checkin=2026-12-19, checkout=2026-12-27, adults=9, min_bedrooms=5) against Mount Dora, Cedar Key, Homosassa, Sarasota, Dunedin, Dade City, Micanopy, Tarpon Springs, Lake Wales, Floral City and Anna Maria and parsed the embedded data-deferred-state JSON for coordinates, room counts and quoted 8-night totals. Where a listing came back quoted 'for 8 nights' it is genuinely bookable across the whole window (marked search_listed with the exact total); where it came back quoted for 4/5/6/7 nights that is Airbnb's near-miss fallback, i.e. the window is partly blocked — I marked those unknown and said so. Inn sites were read directly (curl + WebFetch) for room counts, bed types, buyout language and phone numbers. WHAT PAID OFF AT NINE GUESTS: the 5-room inn buyout is the killer angle. At 6-8 bedrooms the previous pass had to reach for 10-room inns; at 5-6 rooms, small B&Bs that are ALL king rooms come into range, and inn rooms are king rooms far more often than house bedrooms are. Adora Inn (Mount Dora) is literally 5 rooms, 3 of them king — the exact shape of this family. Island Hotel Cedar Key has exactly 3 king rooms (29, 34, 36) among its 10. The Estate at Mount Dora's Main House is 5 private suites, EVERY ONE a king. Second-best angle: two-building compounds — Riverhills Bungalow+Villa in Tampa is two connected homes with 5 king bedrooms, quoted at $6,003 for the full 8 nights. DEAD ENDS CONFIRMED (do not re-chase): Grandview B&B Mount Dora is permanently closed and sold private; The Cypress B&B Sarasota closed 2015; Harrington House Beachfront B&B Anna Maria closed 2020; Dickens House St. Pete shows as closed/for sale. Chinsegut Hill Retreat (1850s manor, Brooksville) is real and gorgeous but its seven cottages are TWO TWIN BEDS per bedroom — zero kings — so it is wrong for three couples. Architecture Sarasota does open Paul Rudolph's Umbrella House and Cocoon House for occasional overnight stays, but they are 1-2 bedroom houses, far too small for nine. adorainn.com, herlong.com and tripadvisor 403/202 blocked direct fetches; details for those came from mirrors and search. Nothing in this file is an invented price, URL or bed count.

properties.name: Adora Inn
properties.neighborhood: N Tremain St, 3 blocks from downtown
properties.compound_note: Five-room historic inn — the whole property IS five rentable rooms, so booking all five is a full buyout with no leftover rooms to pay for. Rooms: Olive (king), Treehouse (king, top of the house, views over the tree canopy), Vanilla (king), Camel (queen, also sold as the Camel Suite), Periwinkle (queen). Ask for the inn at 610 N Tremain St / (352) 735-3110 and request all five rooms plus exclusive use over Christmas week.
properties.beds_note: Per the inn's own room pages: Olive, Treehouse and Vanilla are king rooms; Camel and Periwinkle are queen rooms. Exactly three kings — one per couple — and two good queen rooms for the twenty-somethings, with a fifth room spare.
properties.price_note: Estimate: published high-season rate is $195-199/night per room ($189 on a 3-night Sun-Thu deal), high season runs Sept 29 - May 31, so 5 rooms x ~$199 = ~$995/night x 8 nights = ~$7,960 before any negotiated buyout discount. Holiday-week rates and a whole-inn rate are NOT published — call.
properties.why: This is the closest thing to a purpose-built answer for this exact family: a five-room inn where three of the five rooms are kings and the other two are proper queen rooms. Nine people fill it and nobody sleeps on a sofa. Mount Dora is the Florida Christmas town — the whole downtown is lit for the season and it is a three-block walk — and breakfast is cooked for you every morning, which for eight days with nine adults is worth real money.
properties.cons: About 1h50 from Tampa International, the longest drive in this file after Cedar Key. Small inns often will not do a full-week holiday buyout, or will want a premium for it; there is no published buyout rate so this is a phone call, not a click. No kitchen for a family Christmas dinner — you would be eating out or catering. Rates above are estimated from published nightly rates, not quoted.
properties.drive_note: ~1h50 / ~110 mi northeast of Tampa International via I-4 and SR 46
properties.availability_note: Inn does not expose a public calendar I could read for Dec 19-27 2026; adorainn.com returns 403/202 to automated fetches. Buyout availability and holiday minimums must be confirmed by phone.
properties.min_stay_note: Not published; a 3-night Sun-Thu discount rate is advertised, which implies flexible minimums off-holiday. Holiday minimum unknown.

properties.name: The Estate at Mount Dora — Main House
properties.compound_note: An 1877 landmark estate with two buildings. The MAIN HOUSE books as one unit: five private en-suite guest suites around a shared living room, dining room and full central kitchen. Behind it sits a Carriage House with four more suites (Gardenia with two kings, plus the Lily, Marigold and Willow studios, each king) — the host explicitly invites you to message them to take the whole nine-suite estate. Two more off-site units (The Hideaway, The Retreat) three blocks away. Direct: reservations@estatemountdora.com / 352-630-8126.
properties.beds_note: Verbatim from the listing: Bougainvillea (1 king), Bamboo (1 king + 1 twin), Victoria Rose (1 king + queen sofa bed, clawfoot tub), Azalea (1 king + queen sofa bed), Magnolia (1 king + 1 queen in an adjoining room). Five kings, five private baths.
properties.price_note: Airbnb's dated search returned $1,086.25/night for this listing (quoted as $4,345 for 4 nights — see availability note). 8 nights at that rate would be ~$8,690 before fees. The full nine-suite Estate quoted $1,770.50/night.
amenities: full central kitchen with gas stove and double oven
properties.why: An 1877 National-Register-era estate where all five private suites in the main house have king beds and en-suite baths, wrapped around a shared living room, big dining room and a real cooking kitchen — so you get inn-quality bedrooms AND a house you can cook Christmas dinner in. If the three twenty-somethings want more separation, you can add Carriage House studios (each also a king) and take the whole estate.
properties.cons: The dated Dec 19-27 search returned a 4-night quote rather than an 8-night one, which means part of Christmas week is already blocked on Airbnb — call the estate directly before getting attached. Five kings is two more than the brief wants (you are paying for beds you don't need). 15-minute walk to downtown, not on it. Other guests may be in the Carriage House unless you buy the whole estate.
properties.availability_note: Appeared in the Dec 19-27 2026 dated Airbnb search but priced as '$4,345 for 4 nights' rather than for 8 — Airbnb's near-miss fallback, so the full window is not currently open on Airbnb. The whole-estate listing (9 suites, sleeps 28) behaved the same way at $1,770.50/night. Direct booking may have different inventory: call 352-630-8126.

properties.name: Island Hotel & Restaurant
properties.compound_note: Ten guest rooms above a working restaurant and the Neptune Bar in an 1859 tabby-and-oak building on the National Register. You do not need all ten — book the three king rooms (29, 34, 36) for the couples plus three queen rooms for the adult children and you have a six-room block; or ask about taking the whole hotel over Christmas week. Contact 352-543-5111.
properties.beds_note: From the hotel's own room list: kings in rooms 29, 34 and 36; queens in 23, 27, 32, 33 and 35; room 30 is a double queen; room 28 is a double twin. Exactly three king rooms — one per couple.
properties.price_note: Nightly rates are not published on the hotel site and no buyout rate is advertised. Price by phone.
amenities: Neptune Bar with historic Dali-esque mural
original hand-cut wooden walls and floors
walk to the Cedar Key waterfront
properties.why: The single most atmospheric building in this file — an 1859 hotel that survived hurricanes, the pencil-mill boom and the fishing bust, with hand-cut wood walls, a veranda, a restaurant downstairs and a bar with a famous painted mural. It happens to have exactly three king rooms, which is exactly three couples, and Cedar Key at Christmas is empty, cold-ish, oyster-strewn and completely un-Florida.
properties.cons: 2h15 from Tampa, the longest drive here. It is a hotel, not a house — no kitchen, no shared living room, so the family gathers in the restaurant or the veranda rather than a living room of their own. Rooms are old-building small and some baths are period. Rates and whether they will do a holiday-week block are unknown until you call.
properties.drive_note: ~2h15 / ~125 mi northwest of Tampa International via US-19 and SR 24
properties.availability_note: No public dated calendar readable for Dec 19-27 2026. Room inventory and bed types confirmed from the hotel's own site; availability and group pricing are a phone call.

properties.name: Meranova Guest Inn
properties.compound_note: A fully renovated 1910 house turned into 9 distinct apartments and suites (5 apartments + 4 suites), each with its own private entrance, private bath and a kitchen ranging from efficiency to full. The inn explicitly advertises a 'Whole House Discount' for reserving all 9 units — a published buyout, which is rare. You could also take 5-6 units. Call (727) 733-9248 or text (813) 767-1426.
properties.beds_note: Not stated per-unit. The inn says all units are 'fully furnished with king and queen-sized beds' but does not publish which unit has which — ask them to allocate three king units to the three couples.
properties.price_note: Individual units have been seen listed roughly $146-$462/night (queen ~$170, executive ~$196, standard ~$198 per third-party aggregators). The Whole House Discount rate is not published — ask directly.
amenities: walk to downtown Dunedin Main Street
properties.why: The only property in this file that PUBLISHES a whole-house buyout offer, and it is 25 minutes from Tampa International. Nine self-contained apartments in a 1910 house means every couple and every adult child gets a private entrance, private bath and their own kitchen — the maximum-independence version of a family Christmas — with downtown Dunedin's lit-up Main Street, breweries and Honeymoon Island a short walk away.
properties.cons: Nine units is more than nine people need; even at a discount you may be paying for empty rooms unless they'll sell you five. Bed types are not published per unit, so 'three kings' has to be pinned down on the phone. There is no single big shared living room or dining table — the family would gather in one apartment or out. Downtown-adjacent means street noise.
properties.drive_note: ~25-30 min / ~22 mi west of Tampa International over the Courtney Campbell
properties.availability_note: No readable public calendar for Dec 19-27 2026. The buyout offer itself is confirmed from the inn's own About page.
properties.min_stay_note: Not published; the inn says to contact them for rates and minimum-stay requirements

properties.name: Sea Breeze Manor Inn
properties.neighborhood: 5701 Shore Blvd S, on Boca Ciega Bay
properties.compound_note: A 1923 waterfront manor run as a 6-7 suite inn (sources vary between 'six suite' and 'seven suite'). The inn's own site repeatedly offers exclusive use: 'reserve the entire property', 'Reserve our entire home' — normally pitched at weddings, which means the buyout machinery already exists. There is also a commercial kitchen on site available to rent, so you could cater or cook Christmas dinner. Call (727) 343-4445.
properties.beds_note: Not stated per-suite. The inn advertises 'Spacious king suites' as a headline feature — confirm how many are king when you call.
properties.price_note: No published nightly or buyout rate. Whole-property pricing is quoted case by case (they run it as a wedding/event venue).
properties.why: A bayfront 1920s manor 30 minutes from Tampa where the entire property is routinely rented out to one group, every suite has its own balcony and sitting area, and the headline room type is a king suite. Gulfport itself is the best small weird waterfront town in Pinellas — art galleries, the Casino ballroom, a Tuesday market — and you are across the street from the beach on Boca Ciega Bay.
properties.cons: Room count is inconsistent across sources (6 vs 7 suites) and bed types per suite are not published — both need confirming. It functions primarily as a wedding venue, so Christmas week may already be booked for an event, and buyout pricing is event-shaped rather than nightly. No published rates at all.
properties.drive_note: ~30-35 min / ~25 mi southwest of Tampa International via the Gandy or I-275
properties.availability_note: No readable public calendar for Dec 19-27 2026. The whole-property rental offer is confirmed verbatim from the inn's own site.

properties.name: Cedar Key Bed & Breakfast
properties.neighborhood: Historic district, walk to the docks
properties.compound_note: Built in 1880 as the Eagle Pencil Company superintendent's house. Nine units, all with private baths: Miss Ida's Room, Miss Verona's Room, Summer Kitchen, Nanna's Room, The Girl's Room, Jack's Room, The Tree House Suite and a detached Honeymoon Cottage. Four rooms have antique clawfoot tubs. Take six of the nine or ask about the whole house — (352) 543-9000, info@cedarkeybandb.com.
properties.beds_note: Not stated on the public rates page — the per-room pages are behind a bot block. Ask which rooms are king when you call.
properties.price_note: Published rates: $165/night Sun-Thu, $180/night Fri-Sat. Six rooms at $180 = $1,080/night, ~$8,640 for 8 nights, before any negotiated whole-house rate. Holiday pricing not stated.
properties.why: An 1880 pencil-company superintendent's house in the middle of Cedar Key with a Tree House Suite and a detached Honeymoon Cottage among its nine units — enough oddball room variety that the three couples and three adult children each end up somewhere they'd remember. Published rates are genuinely modest for a Christmas week, and the whole island is a five-minute walk.
properties.cons: 2h15 from Tampa. Bed types per room are not published and the site blocks automated reads, so the three-kings question is unanswered. Nine rooms is more than needed. No shared kitchen for a family dinner. Cancellation policy is tight (7 days, then full amount or a $50 rebooking fee).
properties.availability_note: No readable dated calendar for Dec 19-27 2026; the rooms detail pages return a bot block. Published nightly rates are real and taken from the inn's own Room Rates page.

properties.name: Heron Cay Lakeview Bed & Breakfast Inn
properties.neighborhood: 495 W Old US Hwy 441, overlooking Lake Dora
properties.compound_note: Eight guest rooms in a Key West-style Victorian on 2-3 landscaped acres above Lake Dora, four blocks' walk from downtown. Every room has a full private bath, fridge, TV and embroidered robes, and a gourmet breakfast is cooked daily. One room (ZOI Garden) is ADA-compliant and pet-friendly. Innkeeper Margie answers the phone directly at 352-383-4050.
properties.beds_note: Not stated on the site — ask Margie which rooms are king.
properties.price_note: No rates published on the site; the inn directs you to its booking system or to call.
properties.why: The second Mount Dora option and the prettiest setting of the three — a big verandaed Victorian on three acres of gardens above Lake Dora, four blocks from a downtown that goes fully lit for Christmas, with a real cooked breakfast every morning. Eight rooms means you can take five or six and still have the run of the porches and grounds.
properties.cons: No buyout language anywhere on the site and no published rates — this is entirely a phone call, and small owner-run inns often decline a full-week holiday block. Bed types unknown. Eight rooms means the family may be sharing the house with other guests unless you take it all. 1h50 from Tampa.
properties.availability_note: No readable dated calendar for Dec 19-27 2026; room count and amenities confirmed from the inn's own site.

properties.name: Herlong Mansion Bed & Breakfast
properties.neighborhood: 402 NE Cholokka Blvd, Florida's oldest inland town
properties.compound_note: An 1845 mansion on the National Register with 13 named rooms and suites across three floors (Azalea, Dogwood, Herlong, Magnolia, Palm, Rose, Camellia, Iris, Jasmine, Oak, Wisteria) PLUS two detached private cottages — the Carriage House and the Pump House Cottage. The mansion is regularly rented whole for groups of up to about 24. The detached cottages are the natural pick for the three adult children. Contact (352) 466-3322 / herlongwedding@gmail.com.
properties.beds_note: Not published per room on the site — ask which of the 13 are king.
properties.price_note: No rates or buyout price published. The inn markets whole-property rental for weddings and group retreats, so a buyout number exists — call for it.
properties.why: A columned 1845 mansion in Micanopy — Florida's oldest inland town, all Spanish moss and antique shops — that already does whole-property group rentals for up to 24. The two detached cottages behind the house solve the classic three-adult-children problem: they get their own building, the parents get the mansion.
properties.cons: Two hours from Tampa and the furthest inland. Thirteen rooms is far more than nine people need, so a full buyout means paying for eight empty rooms — negotiate a partial block instead. No bed types or rates published anywhere. The property leans heavily wedding-venue, so Christmas week could be committed. herlong.com blocks WebFetch (403); read via curl.
properties.drive_note: ~2h / ~130 mi north of Tampa International via I-75
properties.availability_note: The site's booking widget lists all 13 rooms plus both cottages but exposes no dated inventory I could read for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Nature Coast Inn and Cottages
properties.compound_note: A 1940s roadside inn that has been running for more than 70 years, now a cluster of named individual cottages — Pink Owl, Crane, Writers and Anglers among them — around a saltwater pool, with its own cafe/bakery (Lollipop's) on site serving breakfast and lunch daily. The site advertises 'all inclusive packages' with special pricing, which is effectively a whole-property buyout offer. Call (352) 646-3282.
properties.beds_note: Not published per cottage — ask. Total cottage count is also not stated online.
properties.price_note: No published rates; the site says all-inclusive package pricing is available and to call for details.
properties.why: A genuine Old Florida cottage court that has been operating since the 1940s, on the edge of the Withlacoochee and the Gulf salt marsh between Yankeetown and Crystal River. Individual cottages mean three couples and three adults each get their own front door, and the on-site bakery-cafe plus complimentary kayaks and bikes takes the pressure off catering an eight-day family holiday.
properties.cons: The single biggest unknown in this file: the site does not say how many cottages there are, how many bedrooms each has, or what the beds are — everything hinges on one phone call. Rural Inglis has almost nothing else around it. No published rates. Cottages of this vintage are charming rather than luxurious.
properties.drive_note: ~1h45 / ~95 mi north of Tampa International via US-19
properties.availability_note: No readable dated inventory for Dec 19-27 2026. The all-inclusive/whole-property offer is confirmed from the inn's own site; the specifics are not.

properties.name: Tri-Sister Suites, Lutterloh Building
properties.compound_note: You rent all three apartments in a historic downtown Cedar Key building as one booking — 'Rose', 'Kate' and 'Eliza', built into the old Lutterloh building with exposed brickwork, historic windows and custom tile. Airbnb counts it as 5 bedrooms / 5 baths across the three units. Comes with private boat-trailer parking in the gravel lot out back and no need for a car once you arrive.
properties.beds_note: Not stated in the listing text; Airbnb's search card reports 5 bedrooms / 5 beds / 5 baths. Message the host to confirm king counts before booking.
properties.price_note: Quoted $4,505 total for the full 8 nights (Dec 19-27 2026) in a dated Airbnb search; was showing as reduced from $4,975.
amenities: walk to everything in Cedar Key
properties.why: Take over an entire historic building in downtown Cedar Key for $4,505 for the whole eight nights — three Victorian-styled apartments, each with its own bath and kitchen, a shared porch for people-watching over the main street, and no car needed once you park. It is the cheapest genuine buyout in this file and it is confirmed available for the exact dates.
properties.cons: Five beds for nine people is tight — confirm the sleeping layout before you commit, and expect at least some sofa beds. No kings confirmed. 2h15 from Tampa. The host warns the historic building can carry some refrigerator-fan noise. Apartments over a street, not a house with a garden.
properties.availability_note: Returned in a dated Airbnb search for checkin 2026-12-19 / checkout 2026-12-27 with 9 adults, quoted at $4,505 for 8 nights — an 8-night quote, so the whole window prices out.

properties.name: Riverhills Bungalow + Villa (two connected homes)
properties.neighborhood: Riverhills, directly on the Hillsborough River
properties.compound_note: Two separate 3,500 sq ft homes — a Bungalow and a Villa — on one riverfront lot, joined by a keypad-locked stairwell so they book as a single property but live as two. Two kitchens, two dining rooms, three living rooms, two washer/dryers. Each half also has its own standalone Airbnb listing (riverhillsbungalow / riverhillsvilla), which is useful leverage if you want to split the booking.
properties.beds_note: Host's own description, verbatim: '5 King Bedrooms, 4 Baths, 2 sofa beds, 1 small child bed.' Every bedroom has high-quality bedding, blackout drapes, bedside USB charging and a ceiling fan.
properties.price_note: Quoted $6,003 total for the full 8 nights (Dec 19-27 2026) in a dated Airbnb search, reduced from $6,642.
properties.why: The best value-for-shape find in this file: two separate houses on one riverfront lot, five king bedrooms, four baths, two kitchens and two dining rooms, confirmed available for the whole 8-night window at $6,003 — about $83 per person per night. Three couples take three kings, the three twenty-somethings take the other house, and everyone still eats at one table when they want to.
properties.cons: Not architecturally special — a well-run bungalow and villa in a residential Tampa neighborhood, not a landmark. Five kings is two more than needed. Four baths for nine adults. Its virtue is layout and price, not character, and it is 5 minutes from Busch Gardens rather than anywhere scenic. No fireplace mentioned.
properties.drive_note: ~25 min / ~14 mi northeast of Tampa International
properties.availability_note: Returned in a dated Airbnb search for checkin 2026-12-19 / checkout 2026-12-27 with 9 adults, quoted at $6,003 for 8 nights — an 8-night quote, so the whole window prices out.

properties.name: Private Waterfront Island Lodge
properties.neighborhood: Private island, boat access only, Gulf-facing
properties.compound_note: Your own island, reachable only by boat, with a quarter mile of Gulf shoreline. A 2,800 sq ft main lodge (industrial kitchen, dining for 10, big downstairs living room and bar, three semi-private upstairs bedrooms) plus a separately renovated 1,000 sq ft bungalow/villa above the outdoor kitchen with its own bedroom, open second sleeping area, kitchenette and full bath. The villa is automatically included above 13 guests; below that you get the main lodge only — so ASK to add it for nine people. Multiple docks for up to 3 boats, fish-cleaning station, outdoor kitchen seating 20.
properties.beds_note: Listing mentions 1 king bed, queen beds, double beds and a single across the rooms; the three upstairs bedrooms are described as 'semi-private' with multiple beds each, sharing one full bath. Exact per-room layout is not published.
properties.price_note: Quoted $6,990 total for the full 8 nights (Dec 19-27 2026) in a dated Airbnb search, reduced from $7,609.
properties.why: Christmas on your own island. Boat-access-only, a quarter mile of Gulf shoreline, manatees and dolphins in the front yard, an outdoor kitchen that seats twenty and a fish-cleaning station — this is the most memorable eight days on the list and it is confirmed available for the full window at $6,990.
properties.cons: Read the honest version: the three upstairs bedrooms are 'semi-private' and SHARE ONE full bath. For three couples in their fifties/sixties and three adults in their twenties over eight nights, that is a real problem unless you also take the bungalow (which is only auto-included above 13 guests — you must ask). Boat access only means every grocery run is a boat trip and there is no bailing out at 10pm. The host warns water must be conserved: it is rainwater collected and filtered. No kings guaranteed. No fireplace.
properties.drive_note: ~1h20 / ~75 mi north of Tampa International to Homosassa, then boat
properties.availability_note: Returned in a dated Airbnb search for checkin 2026-12-19 / checkout 2026-12-27 with 9 adults, quoted at $6,990 for 8 nights — an 8-night quote, so the whole window prices out.

properties.name: Hampton House Homosassa Estate
properties.beds_note: Not fully stated. Airbnb's card reports 5 bedrooms / 7 beds / 5.5 baths; the listing text confirms at least one king plus a single and a toddler bed, and refers to 'the downstairs master bedroom' and 'each master bedroom', implying multiple masters. Confirm king count with the host.
properties.price_note: Quoted $7,213 total for the full 8 nights (Dec 19-27 2026) in a dated Airbnb search.
properties.why: A proper waterfront estate on nearly two acres of oak canopy on the Homosassa River — 5.5 bathrooms for nine people is close to one each, there is a game room upstairs and a gazebo out back, and manatee season peaks in exactly this week. Confirmed available for the whole 8-night window.
properties.cons: Bed configuration is the weak point — the listing text is mostly house rules, and only one king is confirmed. It sits in a residential community with an explicit 10pm-8am quiet request, so a loud family Christmas is discouraged. Not architecturally distinctive. No fireplace mentioned. 1h20 from Tampa.
properties.drive_note: ~1h20 / ~75 mi north of Tampa International via the Suncoast Parkway
properties.availability_note: Returned in a dated Airbnb search for checkin 2026-12-19 / checkout 2026-12-27 with 9 adults, quoted at $7,213 for 8 nights — an 8-night quote, so the whole window prices out.

properties.name: Sapphire Shores — estate with separate guest house
properties.compound_note: Three-storey main house with five bedrooms, EACH with its own full bath and its own outdoor balcony, plus a genuinely separate guest house with its own bedroom suite, kitchen and balcony — so the compound is 5 + 1. That guest house is the natural landing spot for two of the three adult children.
properties.beds_note: Not stated per room; Airbnb's card reports 5 bedrooms / 7 beds / 6 baths. The listing stresses that every bedroom has its own full bath and private balcony. Ask the host for the king count.
properties.price_note: Quoted $9,887 total for the full 8 nights (Dec 19-27 2026) in a dated Airbnb search, reduced from $10,917.
amenities: heated saltwater pool at no extra cost Nov 21 - Apr 1
en-suite bath and private balcony on every bedroom
separate guest house with its own kitchen
properties.why: The only property here with an actual fireplace, a heated pool included free through the exact dates, an en-suite bath AND a private balcony for every single bedroom, and a genuinely separate guest house on top. It sits in Sapphire Shores, one of the three neighborhoods (with Indian Beach and Cherokee Park) that hold the highest concentration of Sarasota School of Architecture houses — so the architecture walk is out the front door even though the house itself is contemporary rather than a Rudolph.
properties.cons: The most expensive confirmed-available option in this file at $9,887 for the week. It is a professionally managed luxury rental with an 'opulence' tone rather than a quirky one-off — if the family wants character rather than crystal chandeliers, this is the wrong end of the spectrum. Bed types not published, so three kings is unconfirmed. About an hour from Tampa.
properties.drive_note: ~1h / ~55 mi south of Tampa International via I-275 and the Skyway
properties.availability_note: Returned in a dated Airbnb search for checkin 2026-12-19 / checkout 2026-12-27 with 9 adults, quoted at $9,887 for 8 nights — an 8-night quote, so the whole window prices out.

properties.name: Blue Bayou Inn (whole Craftsman inn)
properties.neighborhood: 7-minute walk to downtown and the Sponge Docks side
properties.compound_note: A whole Craftsman inn rented as one property: eight bedrooms, EVERY ONE with its own private full bath and its own programmable thermostat. Two refrigerators, a large kitchen, separate living room and TV room, big deck, porch with rockers, generous dining table, washer and dryer.
properties.beds_note: Host's own description, verbatim: 'the choice of 7 rooms featuring queen beds and 1 room adorned with a lavish king-size bed. Each room has its own private full bath.'
properties.price_note: A dated search returned $8,016 for 7 nights (reduced from $12,532) — a 7-night quote, not 8, so treat the per-night figure as indicative only and confirm an 8-night total with the host.
amenities: private full bath on every bedroom
properties.why: A whole eight-bedroom Craftsman inn where every single bedroom has its own private bathroom — nine adults, nine bathrooms' worth of peace — 40 minutes from Tampa in Tarpon Springs, which does Greek Orthodox Christmas and Epiphany better than anywhere in Florida. It is one booking, one house, one big dining table.
properties.cons: Only ONE king. Seven queens means two of the three couples are in a queen for eight nights, which directly contradicts the three-kings goal — this is the property's single disqualifying flaw unless the family is flexible. The Airbnb card also reports the bathroom count oddly ('half-bath'), which conflicts with the host's own text, so verify. The 8-night window did not price (only 7 nights quoted), so availability is unconfirmed.
properties.drive_note: ~40 min / ~30 mi northwest of Tampa International
properties.availability_note: Appeared in the Dec 19-27 2026 dated search but quoted 'for 7 nights', which is Airbnb's near-miss fallback — the full 8-night window did not price. Message the host about Dec 19-27.

properties.name: Westgate River Ranch — Luxe Teepees
properties.neighborhood: 1,700 acres on the Kissimmee River, near Lake Wales
properties.compound_note: Book 4-5 of the Luxe Teepees as a cluster. Each is a 651 sq ft standalone teepee with ONE KING BED plus a full sleeper sofa, its own private bathroom with vanity and a porcelain cast-iron clawfoot tub, a double-sided stone hearth FIREPLACE, screened private patio deck, microwave, mini-fridge, leather chairs, and full A/C and heat. Three teepees cover the three couples in kings; a fourth and fifth give the adult children their own.
properties.beds_note: Per the resort: each Luxe Teepee has 1 king bed and 1 full sleeper sofa, sleeping up to 4. Five teepees = 5 kings + 5 sleeper sofas.
properties.price_note: Resort states all-inclusive Luxe Teepee rates start at $450/night based on double occupancy with a 2-night minimum, and elsewhere quotes 'from $519/night'. Estimate: 5 teepees x ~$450-519 = ~$2,250-$2,600/night, i.e. roughly $18,000-$21,000 for 8 nights. Holiday-week pricing not published — this is the most expensive option here and needs a real quote.
amenities: double-sided stone hearth fireplace in every teepee
properties.why: It is the only place on this list that hands each couple their own king bed in front of their own double-sided stone fireplace, with a clawfoot tub, inside a teepee, on a 1,700-acre working dude ranch with a Saturday rodeo. Rates are all-inclusive of every ranch activity — horseback riding, skeet, the adventure park — which for eight days with nine adults removes all the 'what do we do today' friction that usually kills a long family holiday.
properties.cons: By far the most expensive option here — roughly $18-21k for eight nights at published starting rates, and holiday-week pricing will likely be higher. There is no shared house, kitchen or dining room: you are eating at the ranch's restaurants for eight days, which is the opposite of a home-cooked family Christmas. A 2-night minimum is stated but the resort may not want a single group holding five teepees for a full holiday week. Rates are estimated from published starting prices, not quoted.
properties.drive_note: ~1h50 / ~100 mi southeast of Tampa International via SR 60

properties.name: Wonderfield Farm & Grove — Wonder Village
properties.neighborhood: 10707 E Gobbler Dr, historic orange grove
properties.compound_note: The 'Wonder Village' is a waterfront cluster of four luxury canvas glamp tents (Butterfly, Dragonfly, Citrus and one more) on a 2-acre stretch of a 66-acre historic Old Florida orange grove, regenerative farm and nature sanctuary. Each tent is 12' x 14', 9 ft at the peak, on its own custom wooden deck, with a queen bed, a small kitchenette and solar power. Book all four as a block — call (727) 420-9480 / info@wonderfieldfarm.com.
properties.beds_note: Per the listing: 'A comfortable queen-sized bed' in each tent. Four tents = four queens. No kings.
properties.price_note: Per-tent nightly rates not captured; book-all-four pricing is not published. Call the farm.
amenities: four glamp tents on private decks
spring-fed canal for swimming, kayaking and paddleboarding (equipment provided)
shared fire pits with grills and firewood provided
citrus groves and food forests you may u-pick
indoor bathroom available at the farmhouse
properties.why: A working 66-acre Old Florida orange grove and nature sanctuary 75 minutes from Tampa, where four canvas tents sit on decks along a spring-fed canal — you can pick your own citrus, paddle the canal, walk the cypress swamp and cook over shared fire pits under genuinely dark skies. It is the most distinctive 'stay' idea in the file and the one the family would still be describing to people in ten years.
properties.cons: Be honest about this one: sanitation is eco-friendly outdoor COMPOST TOILETS and an outdoor garden shower, with one indoor bathroom back at the farmhouse for guests who want it. Four queen beds, no kings, sleeping eight — nine people do not quite fit and nobody gets a king. Eight nights in a canvas tent over Christmas is a big ask even in a Florida December. Fire rings, not fireplaces. Booking all four as one block is not a published product.
properties.drive_note: ~1h15 / ~65 mi north of Tampa International via the Suncoast Parkway and SR 48
properties.availability_note: Individual tents are live on Airbnb and Hipcamp but I did not get an 8-night dated quote for the four-tent block; the whole-village booking is a phone call to the farm.
